# `dashboard/views/components.ts`

A collection of UI helper functions that generate HTML strings for dashboard views. The module covers primitive form controls, layout primitives (cards, tables, modals), status indicators, and a multi-step pipeline visualiser.

> **Note:** `sourceBoxes`, `enricherPills`, `routingContent`, and `executionPaths` are **not exported** and are therefore internal implementation details; they are documented here for completeness but cannot be imported directly.

## Types & Interfaces

### `StageState`

```ts
type StageState = /* opaque */
```

Represents the visual/logical state of a single pipeline stage (e.g. complete, active, pending). Used as input/output between [`stageState`](#stagestate-1), [`stageColors`](#stagecolors), and [`renderStage`](#renderstage).

---

### `StageDefinition`

```ts
interface StageDefinition {
  name: string;
  content: string;
}
```

Describes a single pipeline stage.

| Member    | Type     | Description                                      |
|-----------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `name`    | `string` | Display name of the stage.                       |
| `content` | `string` | HTML string rendered inside the stage panel.     |

## Utility

### `escapeHtml`

```ts
import { escapeHtml } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function escapeHtml(str: string): string
```

Escapes a plain string so it is safe to interpolate into HTML markup.

| Parameter | Type     | Description              |
|-----------|----------|--------------------------|
| `str`     | `string` | The raw string to escape.|

**Returns:** `string` — The HTML-escaped string.

**Example:**

```ts
escapeHtml('<script>alert("xss")</script>');
// → '&lt;script&gt;alert(&quot;xss&quot;)&lt;/script&gt;'
```

## Form Controls

### `input`

```ts
import { input } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function input(
  name: string,
  label: string,
  opts?: {
    type?: string;
    value?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
  }
): string
```

Renders a labelled `<input>` field.

| Parameter          | Type      | Description                                  |
|--------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------------|
| `name`             | `string`  | The `name` attribute of the input.           |
| `label`            | `string`  | Visible label text.                          |
| `opts.type`        | `string`  | Input type (defaults to `text` if omitted).  |
| `opts.value`       | `string`  | Pre-filled value.                            |
| `opts.required`    | `boolean` | Marks the field as required.                 |
| `opts.placeholder` | `string`  | Placeholder text.                            |

**Returns:** `string` — HTML markup for the labelled input.

**Example:**

```ts
input('email', 'Email address', { type: 'email', required: true, placeholder: 'you@example.com' });
```

---

### `select`

```ts
import { select } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function select(
  name: string,
  label: string,
  options: { value: string; label: string }[],
  selected?: string,
  attrs?: string
): string
```

Renders a labelled `<select>` dropdown.

| Parameter  | Type                             | Description                                      |
|------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `name`     | `string`                         | The `name` attribute of the select element.      |
| `label`    | `string`                         | Visible label text.                              |
| `options`  | `{ value: string; label: string }[]` | Array of option values and display labels.   |
| `selected` | `string`                         | The `value` of the pre-selected option.          |
| `attrs`    | `string`                         | Additional raw HTML attributes to inject.        |

**Returns:** `string` — HTML markup for the labelled select.

**Example:**

```ts
select(
  'role',
  'User Role',
  [{ value: 'admin', label: 'Admin' }, { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' }],
  'viewer'
);
```

## Layout & Display

### `button`

```ts
import { button } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function button(
  label: string,
  opts?: {
    variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger';
    href?: string;
    attrs?: string;
  }
): string
```

Renders a button or anchor styled as a button.

| Parameter      | Type                                   | Description                                                          |
|----------------|----------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `label`        | `string`                               | Button text.                                                         |
| `opts.variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'danger'` | Visual style of the button.                                          |
| `opts.href`    | `string`                               | When provided, renders an `<a>` tag instead of `<button>`.           |
| `opts.attrs`   | `string`                               | Additional raw HTML attributes to inject.                            |

**Returns:** `string` — HTML markup for the button or anchor.

**Example:**

```ts
button('Delete', { variant: 'danger', attrs: 'hx-delete="/items/1"' });
button('View docs', { variant: 'secondary', href: 'https://docs.example.com' });
```

---

### `table`

```ts
import { table } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function table(headers: string[], rows: string[][]): string
```

Renders an HTML table.

| Parameter | Type         | Description                                              |
|-----------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `headers` | `string[]`   | Array of column header labels.                           |
| `rows`    | `string[][]` | 2-D array of cell content; each inner array is one row.  |

**Returns:** `string` — HTML markup for the table.

**Example:**

```ts
table(
  ['Name', 'Status', 'Created'],
  [
    ['Job A', 'complete', '2024-01-01'],
    ['Job B', 'pending',  '2024-01-02'],
  ]
);
```

```ts
function emptyState(message: string, actionHtml?: string): string
```

Renders an empty-state placeholder with an optional call-to-action.

| Parameter    | Type     | Description                                              |
|--------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `message`    | `string` | Text explaining why there is no content.                 |
| `actionHtml` | `string` | Optional HTML (e.g. a button) for a follow-up action.    |

**Returns:** `string` — HTML markup for the empty state.

**Example:**

```ts

```

## Pipeline

### `getStageIndex`

```ts
import { getStageIndex } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function getStageIndex(status: string): number
```

Maps a status string to a numeric pipeline stage index.

| Parameter | Type     | Description              |
|-----------|----------|--------------------------|
| `status`  | `string` | Current pipeline status. |

**Returns:** `number` — Zero-based index of the matching stage, or `-1` if not found.

### `stageState`

```ts
import { stageState } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function stageState(stageIndex: number, activeIndex: number): StageState
```

Determines the [`StageState`](#stagestate) of a stage relative to the currently active stage.

| Parameter     | Type     | Description                                        |
|---------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `stageIndex`  | `number` | Index of the stage being evaluated.                |
| `activeIndex` | `number` | Index of the currently active stage.               |

**Returns:** [`StageState`](#stagestate)

### `stageColors`

```ts
import { stageColors } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function stageColors(state: StageState): {
  dot: string;
  border: string;
  line: string;
  text: string;
}
```

Returns CSS class strings for each visual part of a stage based on its state.

| Parameter | Type                        | Description                          |
|-----------|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| `state`   | [`StageState`](#stagestate) | The state of the stage to colour.    |

**Returns:** An object with the following fields:

| Field    | Type     | Description                              |
|----------|----------|------------------------------------------|
| `dot`    | `string` | CSS class(es) for the stage indicator dot.|
| `border` | `string` | CSS class(es) for the stage border.       |
| `line`   | `string` | CSS class(es) for the connector line.     |
| `text`   | `string` | CSS class(es) for the stage label text.   |

### `renderStage`

```ts
import { renderStage } from 'dashboard/views/components';

function renderStage(
  stage: StageDefinition,
  stageIndex: number,
  state: StageState,
  isLast: boolean,
  taskBadge?: string
): string
```

Renders the HTML for a single pipeline stage.

| Parameter    | Type                                  | Description                                                   |
|--------------|---------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `stage`      | [`StageDefinition`](#stagedefinition) | The stage definition to render.                               |
| `stageIndex` | `number`                              | Zero-based position of the stage.                             |
| `state`      | [`StageState`](#stagestate)           | Visual/logical state of the stage.                            |
| `isLast`     | `boolean`                             | When `true`, suppresses the connector line after this stage.  |
| `taskBadge`  | `string`                              | Optional HTML badge to display alongside the stage.           |

**Returns:** `string` — HTML markup for the rendered stage.
